:::{#exr-rss-deriv-slope}
#### Derivative of RSS with respect to the slope

Find the partial derivative of the simple linear regression
residual sum of squares $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to the slope, $\derivfslash{\text{RSS}}{\coef{x}}$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-deriv-slope}

Differentiate one operation at a time,
starting from the definition (@exm-rss-slr):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\derivf{\text{RSS}}{\coef{x}}
&= \deriv{\coef{x}} \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)^2
&& \text{(definition of RSS)}\\
&= \sumin \deriv{\coef{x}} (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)^2
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= \sumin 2 (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
  \deriv{\coef{x}} (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(chain rule)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The inner derivative:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\coef{x}} (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&= \derivf{\outvar_\iobs}{\coef{x}}
  - \derivf{\intcoef}{\coef{x}}
  - \derivf{(\coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)}{\coef{x}}
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= 0 - 0 - \predvar_\iobs
&& \text{($\outvar_\iobs$ and $\intcoef$ do not depend on $\coef{x}$)}\\
&= -\predvar_\iobs
&& \text{(subtract)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Plugging the inner derivative back in:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\derivf{\text{RSS}}{\coef{x}}
&= \sumin 2 (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs) (-\predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(inner derivative is $-\predvar_\iobs$)}\\
&= \sumin -2 \predvar_\iobs (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(rearrange the product)}\\
&= -2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
